column1: # --maxk=N: for each falsified literal in the sink, find its best per-literal
#   source; aggregate the top k = min(N, #valid-per-literal-bests), divide
#   each transfer amount by k, apply each. Same source can appear multiple
#   times if it's the per-literal best for multiple literals.
# k=1 (default) = original single-source behavior. k>1 spreads transfer
# across multiple sources -- in expectation each source loses less per
# round, weight rebalancing may be slower but more distributed.
